[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-7c[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Successor Offers — pick which unblocked tasks to pull in after a [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]close[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Closing a task that unblocks other tasks (in Obsidian, bob capture,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]or Bob Mac Capture) still recovers everything immediately, but no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]successor Task Link is created automatically. Instead one grouped [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]picker per gesture offers the direct dependents, every available [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]task of a project whose ^prj the close unblocked (the sase.md ^bar [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]→ sase_foo.md case), and the emptied-project / parent-project ^prj [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pull-ins, with no 5-successor limit. Only the picked tasks are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]linked, raised to Next, and stamped fresh.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
